[[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] incumbent [[Dan Coats]] decided to retire instead of seeking a second full term in office. Democratic former [[Governor of Indiana|governor]] [[Evan Bayh]] won the open seat [[Birch Bayh|his father]] once held.
